rules.statement: A party added under section 18 of the Code of Civil Procedure has the right to plead prescription and claim dismissal on that ground, despite an order adding them as a necessary party.
rules.supporting_quote: "As a matter of construction, I think that Mr. H. J. C. Pereira's contention that section 18 of our own Code of Civil Procedure over-rides the right of an added party to plead prescription is untenable."
